subject: HEBRIDES.
text:
HEBRIDES.
NORTH UIST AND SOUTH UIST WESTWARDS.
1. LIVE WEAPONS FIRINGS IN PROGRESS DAILY BETWEEN 0700 AND 1600 UTC FROM 5 TO 10 OCT IN AREAS WITHIN:
A. 27 MILES OF 57-27.5N 008-20.5W.
B. 20 MILES OF 57-43.5N 008-58.8W.
THESE ARE EXTREMELY HAZARDOUS AREAS AND MARINERS ARE REQUESTED TO VACATE THE AREAS DURING THE ABOVE PERIODS. ANY VESSELS INTENDING TO ENTER THE AREAS SHOULD CONTACT HEBRIDES RANGE ON VHF CH16 OR TELEPHONE NUMBER +441870604449/4452 OR +447787328975 FOR ADVICE. 
MARITIME PATROL AIRCRAFT MAY BE IN OPERATION TO SUPPORT FIRINGS AND MARINERS ARE REQUESTED TO COMPLY WITH ANY INSTRUCTIONS GIVEN.
2. CANCEL THIS MSG 101700 UTC OCT 2026.
